label: docs pass: display numbers (night, 8B scale, 70B weights)

night.where: GitHub-hosted ubuntu-24.04 runner (4 vCPU), installed with deploy/nightly/install.sh --venv, started by systemd (gegenprobe-nightly.service), network mode against files.openparldata.ch
night.triple_check_note: total_s minus the named steps (download, extract, rates, repair_be): the one-time triple check of every new Bern row (first night: all of them), which run.json does not time separately

scale_8b.note: The rules' residue share on the stratified held-out sample (97/154) applied to every document in OPD's docs export, times the measured 8B seconds per document on one 4-vCPU machine (fetch, extraction, model load included). An upper bound for a one-off back-catalogue run; review mode runs only on new answer documents.

weights_70b.note: arithmetic, not measured: 70 billion parameters × 2 bytes (bf16) of weights, before KV cache
